person.name: Shamirkhan Nabil
person.summary: An enterprise architect with deep communications and cybersecurity foundations, hands-on engineering capability, and experience leading delivery.

practice.title: An architect who brings networks, security, systems and AI together.

areas.desc: Enterprise communications, 5G and LTE networking, and VoIP.
Intrusion prevention, threat and rogue-device analysis, packet-level investigation, offensive security and pentesting.
Custom intelligence and enhanced applications, platform support, and infrastructure integration.
RFID, RTLS, edge-to-cloud integration, automation, AI governance, LLM integration, local inference and bounded agentic workflows.

method.title: Business case to delivery.
method.lede: I work with leadership and engineering teams to turn operational problems into a clear architecture, a costed plan and a delivery path, and I stay hands-on through go-live.

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: Business discovery and functional requirements with leadership and engineering, framing the operational problem before any technology is chosen.

steps.title: Architect
steps.body: Solution blueprints, integration boundaries and transition plans, from the business layer down to the radio layer.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: A costed path to delivery: statements of work, levels of effort and bills of materials that leadership can approve.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.body: Hands-on build and troubleshooting across applications, platforms and cloud-to-edge systems, with evidence before go-live.

expertise.title: Ways I can help.
expertise.lede: My capabilities span eight practice areas, from business discovery down to the radio layer.
